synopsis: dSPACE AURELION with SIMPHERA is a commercial simulation platform with on-road-only evidence; the corpus found no public validation of quarry or mining terrain, material or weather fidelity, and terrain physics must come from elsewhere [f8445, f8454, f8455, f15895]. Vendor-described capabilities include real-time camera, ray-traced radar, lidar, infrared and ultrasonic simulation, sensor effects and a material database, available locally or in the cloud for SIL/HIL; however, frame-rate figures were not found [f8446, f4957]. Integration with SCALEXIO, VEOS, ASM and ModelDesk provides a route from SIL to HIL, but sensor injection remains sensor- and ECU-specific rather than a uniform interface task [f8448, f8640, f8641]. The latest AURELION release found was 26.2, dated 15 July 2026; version 25.3 added lidar beam divergence and Hesai models and requires maintenance valid through at least 31 August 2025, while new versions generally require valid maintenance [f9057, f8449, f8450, f16152]. Pricing is quote-only, with no public AURELION/SIMPHERA or full-system price found; the highest-cost example chain combines commercial validation, specialist sensors, external heavy-machine dynamics, benches and cloud execution [f8541, f8453, f8642, f16166, f16167].
